title: LoadBalancer IPs don't seem to be being advertised (pod cidr works)
body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [X] I have searched the existing issues

### What happened?

@reporter You may be running into the same issue that prompted https://github.com/cilium/cilium/pull/32694

Try changing:
```
apiVersion: "cilium.io/v2alpha1"
kind: CiliumLoadBalancerIPPool
metadata:
  name: "wizznet-pool"
spec:
  blocks:
  - cidr: "10.100.198.0/24"
```

To:
```
apiVersion: "cilium.io/v2alpha1"
kind: CiliumLoadBalancerIPPool
metadata:
  name: "wizznet-pool"
spec:
  cidrs:
  - cidr: "10.100.198.0/24"
```

If that solves it, you are hitting the same issue.  I merged a fix, but it literally just went in about a week ago so you're likely not running it :-).

@participant4 In your case it seems to be just incomplete configuration - you are missing a `selector` in the `CiliumBGPAdvertisement` for the `Service` advertisement type. Without selector, no services are advertised. `PodCIDR` advertisement is advertised even without the selector, as there is nothing to select in this case.

@participant3 it would be super-helpful if you could share a sysdump of your system at the point it when is not advertising properly (`cilium sysdump`). If that is not possible, at least the following may help us: in a cilium pod on a node which is missing some advertisements, dump the following: 
 - `cilium-dbg bgp peers`
 - `cilium-dbg bgp routes advertised ipv4 unicast`
 - `cilium-dbg bgp routes advertised ipv6 unicast` 
 - `cilium-dbg bgp route-policies`
 - `cilium-dbg service list`.

Thanks!

@participant3 so the root-case why the svc VIPs are not advertised is that you are missing a route policy for your LB pools in the route-policies. The way it works ATM is that `Service` advertisement selector needs to match both `Service` and the`CiliumLoadBalancerIPPool`, e.g. for this to work:

```yaml
apiVersion: cilium.io/v2alpha1
kind: CiliumBGPAdvertisement
metadata:
  name: bgp-advertisements-internal
  namespace: kube-system
  labels:
    advertise: bgp-internal
spec:
  advertisements:
    - advertisementType: "PodCIDR"
    - advertisementType: "Service"
      service:
        addresses:
          - LoadBalancerIP
      selector:
        matchExpressions:
          - { key: "service-type", operator: In, values: [ "internal" ] }
```

You will need to label the `CiliumLoadBalancerIPPool` from which the service gets VIP with the `service-type: internal` label as well.

Please try that and let us know whether it helped. As this may be a bit counter-intuitive, we will consider removing this requirement.
